events.title: Crochet Workshop: Hand Crochet Chunky Scarf

cases.refreshed: Mt. Pleasant Neighborhood Library will host a crochet workshop to create a chunky scarf. This workshop is an adults-only craft program; all skill levels are welcome to join and sign up. Registration not required. This event is first-come, first-served. Materials are limited to 8 participants. Provided materials include Bernat Jumbo and Chunky yarns for hand crochet. Participants are welcome to bring their own materials. For parking, please use street parking in the neighborhood area as the library is currently sharing the elementary school's parking lot.

events.title: Movie Matinee at Cupertino Library: "The Adventures of Tintin"

cases.refreshed: Join us for the movie - "The Adventures of Tintin" 2011 · PG · 1h 47m Director - Steven Spielberg Featuring the voices of Jamie Bell,(Tintin) Andy Serkis (Captain Haddock) and Daniel Craig (Sakharine). What happens when the young reporter Tintin and his dog Snowy meet Captain Haddock for the first time? Find out on Sunday, December 13th for an afternoon of action, adventure and comedy in this motion capture version of the well-known Tintin series by Herge. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.

cases.sourceText: English as a Second Language (ESL) / Learn English: Beyond the Basics is an in-person 8-week class with lessons on English grammar, pronunciation, and idioms. It is for adult (18 years and older) intermediate and advanced English learners who can have a conversation in English and want to improve their pronunciation and understanding. To register for the entire 8-week series, please include your email address and make sure it is entered correctly. Please register only once for the entire series. Please note: Registrants who do not attend the 1st class may be unregistered. If you cannot attend the 1st class, please email Priya Murthy at priya.murthy@paloalto.gov; Registration closes on the 3rd week of class.
